g.text: Sanitized reconnect/billing guidance; preserve usage and review reason.

BOUNDARY The active protocol has no sequential STT -> text model -> TTS chain. Input transcription assists action gates asynchronously. No routine uploaded JPEG is forwarded to Realtime. Disconnect does not erase saved capture evidence.
Native audio and inventory share one client WebSocket; the gateway owns a separate provider WebSocket.
